popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Eribotes son of Teleon tends Oileus when a Stymphalian bird wounds him, and later dies in Libya on the return — a working Argonaut of the medical pause, not a catalogue filler alone.

popCulture.title: Eribotes
popCulture.description: Argonaut from Locrian Eleon; son of Teleon.
